DIAGNOSIS READY: Pemphigus Vulgaris

The Direct Fluorescent Antibody results showing intercellular IgG and C3 deposition, combined with your clinical findings of flaccid blisters and extensive mucosal involvement, are diagnostic for Pemphigus Vulgaris. This rules out the earlier possibility of cellulitis or other conditions.
